milestone_brief:
Disambiguate the operator-console status badge in server/routes/ui.py::ui_status_badge so that retrieval-degraded states (corpus/embedder/lancedb/notebooks) and ops-warn states (backup time, disk utilization, process uptime) render with distinct labels and styles. Today both render identically as 'DEGRADED', which was actively misleading after restic-not-yet-run produced a backup:time warn on an otherwise-pass corpus.

Acceptance criteria:
1. When lancedb:status, corpus:version, embedder:status, or notebooks:count is non-pass, badge label includes 'DEGRADED'.
2. When ONLY backup:time, disk:utilization, or process:uptime is non-pass, badge label is 'WARN' (not 'DEGRADED').
3. Existing badge tests in tests/test_routes_ui.py (search for status-badge / ui_status_badge) updated for the new disambiguation.
4. make test green, ruff clean, BP1/tool-schema hashes unchanged (no MCP surface touched).
5. No new dependencies, no SPA, no JS beyond htmx. status-badge--warn already exists in frontend/static/app.css; possibly add an --ops-warn variant for clarity.

Scope: server/routes/ui.py::ui_status_badge (lines 162-195 in current HEAD), frontend/templates as needed, frontend/static/app.css for any new style variant, tests/test_routes_ui.py for assertions.
